This will return the stale value, Not new value. Start_detach and return stale value doesn't sit together
What would be the alternative to `start_detach`?

Currently, in the latest patch I am using `scope.spawn`. If we add to that `scope.on_empty` to wait for the set operation to finish, it's a deadlock as this is a single threaded event loop. There doesn't seem to be any other alternative. I think it should be fine if the updated value is reflected after some time.
Since you have a global namespace added, lg2 here is not needed, just info() would be good.
